# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }} Every page of {{ origin }} as markdown, for agents: each library's README and docs, at the release the site shows.

The first section is the site itself; each one after it is a library. Its first link is its README, with its version, group, install command, repository and the exact versions it pins of the other libraries here; the rest are its docs, in reading order. The same index as HTML: {{ origin }}/doc/

Every library here, in Python, C or C++, follows the same rules, and a new one must too: its name, its releases, its metadata (`pyproject.toml`, or `CMakeLists.txt` and the README's `## Dependencies`) and the shape of its README and docs. The site checks them at each library's latest release, and a library joins it when it follows them and is added to `site.toml` in {{ site.repo }}.

## The site

- [The rules and how the site works]({{ origin }}/doc/site.md): the README of {{ site.repo }}, the rules every library follows first.
